blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Length / Story

blocks.source: 前作のスターオーシャンは20時間もあれば十分クリアできる短さだったが、今回はプレイ時間が倍以上に長くなった。ＰＳのＲＰＧとしては標準レベルといったところか。
blocks.translation: The previous Star Ocean was short enough to clear in just 20 hours, but this time the playtime is more than twice as long. For a PlayStation RPG, I suppose it is about average.

blocks.source: 主人公はクロードかレナのどちらかを選択する方式で、ストーリー展開や仲間にできるキャラクターが多少異なる。自由度はそれなりに高く、十数人いるキャラクターの中から８人を仲間にできる。
blocks.translation: You choose either Claude or Rena as the protagonist, and the story development and available party members differ somewhat. The game offers a fair degree of freedom, allowing you to recruit eight of the more than ten available characters.

blocks.source: ＳＦっぽい世界設定であるが、中盤までは他の多くのＲＰＧと変わらずファンタジー世界の冒険をすることになるのは前作と一緒。ただし、後半の展開はかなり唐突。ある意味インパクトは大きいが……。億単位の年数が普通に使われるなど、設定は無駄に壮大だけど、そのほうがＳＦらしいか。
blocks.translation: Although it has a sci-fi-like setting, just as in the previous game, until around the middle you will go on an adventure in a fantasy world much like those in many other RPGs. However, the developments in the latter half are quite abrupt. In a sense, they make a strong impact, though... The setting is needlessly grandiose, casually using spans of hundreds of millions of years, but perhaps that makes it feel more like science fiction.

blocks.source: セリフ回しはあまり褒められたレベルではないかも。あまり気にしない僕でも、このゲームは珍しく気になった。
blocks.translation: The dialogue may not be at a particularly praiseworthy level. Even I, who usually do not care much about such things, found it unusually noticeable in this game.

blocks.source: 序盤の村長を始めとした会話が冗長。無意味な「…」の乱用。
blocks.translation: The conversations, starting with the village chief early on, are verbose. There is excessive use of meaningless “...”

blocks.source: 無味乾燥なのに冗長……。
blocks.translation: Verbose despite being bland...

blocks.source: 終盤の敵との会話で、敵のセリフをオウム返しする主人公。
blocks.translation: In conversations with enemies near the end, the protagonist simply parrots their lines.

blocks.source: などが特に。
blocks.translation: Those are especially notable.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: System

blocks.source: アクションＲＰＧの様な戦闘が魅力。操作キャラクターは１人だけだが、主人公以外のキャラクターも選択できる。他のキャラクターには指示を与えるのみ。
blocks.translation: The action RPG-style battles are the game's appeal. You control only one character at a time, but you can choose someone other than the protagonist. The other characters can only be given commands.

blocks.source: アクション性があるといっても、敵の攻撃を回避する等のテクニカルな操作はあまりできない。結局はボタン連打で殴り合っているような印象。作りは粗いが、それでも技で敵をボコボコにするのは爽快。
blocks.translation: Although the battles have an action element, there is not much technical maneuvering, such as evading enemy attacks. In the end, it feels like trading blows while repeatedly mashing buttons. The execution is rough, but it is still exhilarating to pummel enemies with special techniques.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: 敵の出現率はかなり高めな上に、気を抜くとザコ敵にあっさり全滅させられる。また、後半の一部ボスが異様に強かったりと、かなりシビア。
blocks.translation: Enemies appear very frequently, and if you let your guard down, even weak enemies can easily wipe out your party. Some bosses in the latter half are also absurdly strong, making the game quite unforgiving.

blocks.source: 中でも、終盤のミカエル＆ハニエルはＲＰＧ全体の中でも壁ボスとして有名。反面、一部キャラの通常攻撃や技の連打が異様に強力で、ボスでもハメ殺しできたりと極端。
blocks.translation: In particular, Michael and Haniel near the end are famous as wall bosses even among RPGs as a whole. Conversely, repeatedly using normal attacks or techniques with certain characters is absurdly powerful, to the point that even bosses can be locked down and killed. It is extremely uneven.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 呪紋（いわゆる呪文）や一部特技では演出のため、戦闘が停止するのだけど、このアニメが非常に長い。後半の呪紋の長さはＦＦ７以降の召喚（カット無し）に匹敵するレベル。頻度の多さを考えると、同時期のＦＦより辛いかも。せっかくのアクション風戦闘がもったいない。
blocks.translation: Battles pause for the effects of Symbology (so-called spells) and some Techs, but these animations are extremely long. The later Symbology animations rival the summons in Final Fantasy VII and later entries (without cuts). Considering how frequently they occur, they may be more punishing than those in Final Fantasy games from the same period. It is a waste of the otherwise action-like battles.

blocks.source: 筆者はこのせいで、攻撃呪紋系キャラのセリーヌをパーティから外したほど。もっとも、味方が呪紋を使わなくても、敵が連発してくるので、このイライラは避けようないのだけど……。
blocks.translation: Because of this, I even removed Celine, the party's offensive Symbology user, from my party. Even if your allies do not use Symbology, however, enemies will spam it, so this frustration is unavoidable...

blocks.source: 戦闘中のアイテムや呪紋メニューの使いにくさは嫌がらせレベル。特にアイテムは、数が豊富で使用頻度も低くない割りに、同時に４つずつしか、画面に表示できない。目当てのアイテムを選択するだけでも一苦労。
blocks.translation: The difficulty of using items and the Symbology menu during battle reaches the level of deliberate harassment. Items in particular are numerous and used fairly often, yet only four can be displayed on screen at a time. Even selecting the item you want is a major ordeal.

blocks.source: 戦闘以外では、セリフの「…」にウェイトをかけまくっているのが気になる。前述した村長との会話で、序盤からプレイヤーに試練を与えてくる。
blocks.translation: Outside of battle, the excessive delays attached to the “...” in dialogue are bothersome. As in the aforementioned conversation with the village chief, the game starts testing the player's patience right from the beginning.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ドット絵のキャラクターと３ＤＣＧで作られたマップの組み合わせ。ただ、結構無理している感も。キャラクターを拡大縮小することによって、遠近を表現しているのだけど、縮小時にキャラクターが潰れる。このレベルならば、ドット絵で統一したほうがよかったなと。
blocks.translation: It combines pixel-art characters with maps made using 3D CG. However, it also feels like quite a forced compromise. Perspective is represented by scaling the characters up and down, but they become squashed when reduced. At this level, I think it would have been better to use pixel art consistently.

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメーションに付いては、種類も多く派手。ただし、上述の通り後半の呪紋は長い。
blocks.translation: The battle animations are numerous and flashy. However, as mentioned above, the later Symbology animations are long.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: フィールドや通常戦闘曲は長く聞くと、かなり作りこまれた曲であることが分かる。後半はボスごとに曲が変わるなど豪華。時にはちょっと騒がしすぎるかな、ということもあるけれど。
blocks.translation: If you listen to the field and regular battle themes for a while, you can tell that they are very carefully crafted. The latter half is lavish, with the music changing for each boss. At times, though, it can feel a little too noisy.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 元々、開発チームが同じだったテイルズシリーズに似ているとよく言われるが、実際プレイしてみると、かなり印象が異なる。テイルズと比較すると、シナリオ・システム共に荒削りで、自由度が高いがバグも多い。何となく、テイルズがＦＦならば、こちらはサガに近いイメージ。
blocks.translation: It is often said to resemble the Tales series, which originally had the same development team, but when you actually play it, the impression is quite different. Compared with Tales, both the scenario and system are rough around the edges; it offers a high degree of freedom but also has many bugs. Somehow, if Tales is Final Fantasy, this feels closer to SaGa.

blocks.source: 初代ロマンシングサガ等と同じく、荒削りな作品なので、点数を付けると、どうしても低くなってしまうけれど、これはこれで魅力はあると思う。
blocks.translation: Like the original Romancing SaGa and similar games, it is a rough-around-the-edges work, so inevitably the score ends up low when I rate it. Even so, I think it has its own appeal.

blocks.source: ちなみに、ＰＳＰでリメイクもされているので、購入を検討する場合はそちらもどうぞ。筆者は未プレイだが、長かった呪紋のアニメなども多少マシになっているらしい。タイトルはスターオーシャン2 セカンド エヴォリューションとのこと。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, it was also remade for the PSP, so consider that version if you are thinking of buying it. I have not played it, but apparently the once-lengthy Symbology animations and such have been improved somewhat. Its title is Star Ocean 2: Second Evolution.
